paragraphs.text: Talion , known as "the Kindly Lord, First and Greatest of the High Fae, Sovereign of the Court, the Liege of Laughter, Finder of the First Yew, and the One True Lord of Eldraine" is a faerie noble serving as the Fae Lord of the Wilds of Eldraine . The fae duelist Obyra is one of their daughters.

Talion is otherworldly, ancient, and fickle. They have piercing, gold-colored eyes and wear black robes, delicately pointed boots, a crown, and carry a hawthorn wand. While they are the ruler of Eldraine's fae, they also consider themselves the protector of all of Eldraine's people. Despite having an austere demeanor, the Kindly Lord is also known for following mysterious whims, journeying to the farthest reaches of Eldraine out of an insatiable curiosity.
Talion is based on the the Wicked fairy of Sleeping Beauty .

Before the New Phyrexian Invasion , Talion and their High Fae court returned from a long journey to the edge of the plane. They were forced to join with the witch sisters Agatha , Eriette , and Hylda to create the Wicked Slumber . In exchange for helping to cast the Slumber, Talion provided each of the witches with a magical artifact that enhanced their powers. After Eriette extended the curse to Eldraine's citizens, including Talion's daughter, Obyra , they tasked the knight Imodane to kill the three witches. When she was caught by Agatha , Talion handed the task to the half-fae Kellan , promising him information about his fae father if Kellan could end the curse by defeating all three witches. Kellan retrieved the cauldron and the crown, but, increasingly perceiving his aid to Talion as immoral, chose to abandon the assignment, thereby prolonging the Wicked Slumber until Eriette could be defeated and captured by Will Kenrith .

Talion gave the witch sisters Agatha , Eriette , and Hylda each a magical artifact that enhanced their powers. Agatha received the Vile Cauldron , which allowed her to boil down the essence of those within. Months later, Kellan killed her by boiling her alive in the cauldron before returning it to Talion. Hylda was given the Icy Crown, which greatly enhanced her powers, allowing her to bury the entire plane in snow and ice should she want to. Preferring isolation, she chose to rule over her own kingdom until begrudgingly relinquishing the crown to Kellan to return to Talion. To Eriette, Talion gave the Charmed Apple, which granted her the love of anyone who took a bite. Though Eriette was eventually defeated by Will Kenrith, she was able to escape off-plane with the apple, the only one of Talion's gifts they could not recover.
